name: v0.11.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Update SECURITY_ADVISORY.md by @ShreyaR in https://github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails/pull/1499
* chore: add grouped Dependabot config by @zsimjee in https://github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails/pull/1500
* [Aikido] Fix security issue in aiohttp via minor version upgrade from 3.13.3 to 3.13.5 by @aikido-autofix[bot] in https://github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails/pull/1468
* Feat/remove code cov by @zsimjee in https://github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails/pull/1526
* update dependabot and deps by @zsimjee in https://github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails/pull/1528
* chore(deps): resolve Dependabot security alerts by @zsimjee in https://github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails/pull/1536
* [Aikido] AI Fix for Template Injection in GitHub Workflows Action by @aikido-autofix[bot] in https://github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails/pull/1537
* [GR-1710] Adopt guardrails-ai-types 0.5.0; construct results with field-name kwargs by @zsimjee in https://github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails/pull/1571
* Bump the github-actions group across 1 directory with 6 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails/pull/1576
* [GR-1710] Deprecate hub CLI + private registry; move to public PyPI (WS-G/H/I) by @zsimjee in https://github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails/pull/1548
* [GR-1767] Auto-cut a GitHub Release on PyPI publish by @zsimjee in https://github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails/pull/1586
* [GR-1766] Security: bump anyio to 4.14.2 and fix GitHub Action template injection by @zsimjee in https://github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails/pull/1585
* Pre-0.11.0 Release Patch by @CalebCourier in https://github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails/pull/1621
* fix fixable notebooks, ignore notebook for unpublished validator by @CalebCourier in https://github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails/pull/1623


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails/compare/v0.10.2...v0.11.0
